observations: 4 photos show the same black-caged pedestal stand fan from near-identical angles, no variation in background or lighting.
Fan has brown/wood-toned plastic blades and a brass/gold motor hub with a small red logo badge that is too small and blurred to read any brand name.
A cast-iron style round base and telescoping pole are visible; no plug, switch panel, or cord is shown in any frame.
All four photos carry a visible watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BLESSING ODII', identical to the watermark seen on comparable #1 (OX 20-Inch Standing Fan, Lagos listing).
No speed-control knob, remote, or power indicator is visible to support an 'on/working' state.
No packaging, receipt, or purchase date shown to support a 'brand new' claim.

claims.evidence: No packaging, invoice, or purchase proof in any photo; blades show no dust/wear but that alone does not confirm newness.
No photo or clip shows the fan plugged in, spinning, or powered on.

risks.risk: Fan may not power on or motor may be faulty
risks.proof: A short video clip of the fan plugged in and spinning at multiple speeds

risks.risk: Photos appear identical (including watermark text) to a separate existing advert (comparable #1), suggesting reused/stock images rather than the actual item being sold
risks.proof: Fresh, unwatermarked photos taken by the seller today, ideally with a handwritten note/date visible, plus a live video call showing the actual unit
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unverifiable for authenticity; cannot confirm this seller actually possesses the item

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed, affecting true market comparables
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the hub logo/badge
risks.if_unproven: priced using generic standing-fan comparables only

risks.risk: Cord, plug, or switch condition unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord, plug, and switch/speed control panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as if electrical components are unverified/worst-case

proof_requests: Live video call or clip showing the fan plugged in and running at each speed
Clear, unwatermarked close-up of the brand badge/logo on the hub
Fresh photo of the cord, plug, and switch panel taken today
Any purchase receipt or box to support the 'brand new' claim
response.reason: The four submitted photos carry the same watermark and appear to be the identical image set used in a separate, differently-branded listing (comparable #1), raising a strong signal of reused/stock photos rather than proof that this seller actually holds the item; combined with zero evidence the fan powers on, this cannot be safely priced as a genuine working item.
